capabilities: Track daily events with linked notes, start times, and postponement
Log daily metrics such as weight, sleep, or expenses with monthly history
Manage categorized tasks synced two-way with note checklists
Check in habits with colored buttons, streaks, and custom cycles
Capture timestamped daily moments and outline monthly plans
disambiguation: Not just a habit tracker; it is a broader daily dashboard that also covers events, tasks, metrics, moments, and monthly planning.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; interface supports Chinese and English, and the timer keeps running across Obsidian restarts.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a modified version of Yori Dashboard by yoriGo77
problem: Obsidian has no single at-a-glance daily page combining habit tracking, task management, metric logging, and planning; users must assemble these from separate views.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a modified version of Yori Dashboard by yoriGo77, used and redistributed under the MIT License

summary: Dashboard plugin that gathers daily events, data logs, tasks, habit check-ins, moments, monthly plans, and quick links into one editable page.
